source.name: Cheyenne / Laramie County Citizen Connect
source.publisher: Cheyenne Police Department & Laramie County Sheriff's Office
source.refreshCadence: Publisher states the underlying data refreshes roughly every three days.
source.attributionNote: Citizen Connect is the agencies’ public dashboard; the linked page describes its coverage, refresh cadence, and privacy exclusions.

coverage.note: The dashboard's date picker opens at 2020, but substantive volume begins in 2023; 2020–2022 contains only sparse records. Treat pre-2023 as pre-launch, not as low crime.

layers.label: Incidents
layers.description: Computer-aided-dispatch activity: citizen calls for service and officer/deputy-initiated events. A dispatch record is not, by itself, a police report or proof that a crime occurred.

layers.label: Cases
layers.description: A separate Cases dataset with its own reported_date_time field. The public record does not link any one Incidents row to any one Cases row.

sampleDescription: Most recent 60 located records returned by the publisher's public pin endpoint; subject to the stated refresh delay.
